caption: The drawing depicts two views of a sculptural object featuring a bird and a nest. In both views, the main object consists of a large bird with outstretched wings, patterned in shades of grey, brown, and muted blue, standing on a multicolored, marbled base composed of green, brown, and hints of reddish tones. The bird's head is turned to the left, showing a detailed beak and eye. Directly in front of the bird is a nest containing three open-mouthed chicks, all rendered in shades of brown and grey. The nest rests on an elevated portion of the base that is shaped and textured to resemble a natural landscape. The base has hooks on either side and displays a small, orange animal face—possibly a decorative addition—on the front. The top left corner of the drawing provides a smaller, monochromatic rendering of the same object, showing the bird, nest, and chicks with less color and detail, mainly in greys and blacks. The scripted text "Geo. J. Fite" appears in the lower right corner of the composition. The background is plain and beige, with no additional decorative elements.
title: Toy Bank: Bird
